methodology.duration: median measured warm wall-clock seconds; includes partitioning, serialization, worker dispatch, validation and canonical reduction; excludes generation, Ray startup and warmup
methodology.startup: Ray startup plus ready handshake with one distinct actor process per worker
methodology.latency: worker canonical evaluator time per partition, milliseconds; not per-episode inference latency
methodology.speedup: same-dataset median Ray 1-worker duration / median current duration
methodology.reduction: B1 reevaluation of validated worker observations in input order plus partition verification; serial overhead is included
methodology.provenance: commit identifies checkout at run; source_sha256 identifies exact Python source and pyproject bytes when dirty
methodology.samples: all repetitions retained; successful_tasks/failed_tasks refer to worker tasks, not robot task success
methodology.scope: single-machine local Ray actors; no multi-node claims
